label: iPhone 13 smartphone
description: Apple iPhone 13 — 6.1-inch smartphone with Wi-Fi 6 and 5G (sub-6 GHz, mmWave on US models); Lightning port, no Ethernet.
notes: Wi-Fi 6 (802.11ax, 2x2 MIMO, 2.4/5 GHz, 80 MHz) — same radio class as iPhone 12, still no 6 GHz. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave on US SKUs, LTE fallback. Lightning = USB 2.0 only, so no usb0 Ethernet interface. Modelled without mmWave-specific port; treat wwan0 as sub-6 with mmWave opportunistically available in US deployments.
